title: WEEKDAY of a Sunday: 1 by default, 7 with type 2, 6 with type 3
query: EVALUATE VAR s = DATE ( 2005, 1, 2 ) RETURN ROW ( "default", WEEKDAY ( s ), "t1", WEEKDAY ( s, 1 ), "t2", WEEKDAY ( s, 2 ), "t3", WEEKDAY ( s, 3 ) )

source.quote: WEEKDAY returns the day of the week using different standards
source.supports: the example table lists 2005-01-02, Sunday, with Weekday 1, Weekday 1 = 1, Weekday 2 = 7, Weekday 3 = 6

source.quote: Return type: 3 , week begins on Monday (0) and ends on Sunday (6).numbered 0 through 6.
